title: Record follow-up
purpose: Record what was done about material already distributed when the participant withdrew.

sections.title: Withdrawal details
paragraphs: The form identifies the consent and shows the original withdrawal's kind and effective date. If it was escalated, the form also shows the destruction instruction and its own effective date.

items.label: Shipment
items.description: Required. Shipments that contained this participant's material in the study; opened from a shipment row it is chosen.

items.label: What was done
items.description: Recipient notified, Destruction confirmed by recipient, Material returned, Recipient unable to act, or Note.

items.label: Note
items.description: Required: what happened. Do not enter names, signatures, record numbers, birth dates or contact details of a participant.

items.label: Attachment
items.description: Optional PDF, PNG, JPEG, TXT or CSV up to 10 MiB, checked by its content; downloaded only as a file. Do not upload consent forms, signatures or any document that identifies a participant.

sections.title: Rules
paragraphs: Only admin and manager can open or submit this form; other roles are refused. The server repeats every check when you save.
The form opens in a dialog over the page you came from; opened directly it is a full page. Cancel returns to that page without saving.

The software sends nothing and does not recall material; this records what people did. Not available when no shipment carried the participant's material. Follow-ups cannot be edited; record another one.
